experiments.hypothesis: Profile: share of cycles per phase, ours against C5 and Rust
experiments.note: Dense is 60-70% of the base gap; sparse 15-30%. No PMU on Azure; TSC phase builds used.

experiments.hypothesis: Vector dense resets (per-lane single-bit ORs folded into constant vectors)
experiments.note: Confirmed on fresh nodes. Merged as 4d35020. Base now beats Rust at 1T on Zen 3 and Zen 4.

experiments.hypothesis: Pointer walk over sparse chunks (27 to 11 instructions per 8 ORs)
experiments.note: Prediction for Zen 5 too low (said 4-8%). Merged into hc/champion as cacfd8f.

experiments.hypothesis: Lone prime 13 skips the fused group loop
experiments.note: Merged into hc/champion.

experiments.hypothesis: No masked stores in the group loop and tails
experiments.note: Good on AVX2, slight loss with AVX-512. Follow-up: AVX2-only variant.

experiments.hypothesis: Build with --addressing=64 (no sign extension per strided OR)
experiments.note: Accepted via the clean Zen 3 rerun (hc-006b).

experiments.hypothesis: Unmasked group loop and tail overrun, AVX2/SSE only
experiments.where: Zen 3 +3.7%/+4.4%, AVX2 Zen 4 +5.3%/+3.8%, Zen 5 identical code
experiments.note: Waiting for Chris: the rule needs 2% on Zen 5, which this change cannot move. Recommend keep.

experiments.hypothesis: Tile copy by doubling memcpy (was scalar 8-byte moves)
experiments.note: Tile copy too small to matter.

experiments.hypothesis: hc-006 (--addressing=64) rerun on Zen 3, rebased on champion 0175d18
experiments.note: Merged into hc/champion.

experiments.hypothesis: Next-prime scan a word at a time (count trailing zeros)
experiments.note: Stopped early; scan already cheap.

experiments.hypothesis: Re-profile both champions on Zen 5 (TSC phase builds and perf)
experiments.note: Base matches Rust phase for phase (38k dense, 61k sparse). Wheel: sparse 52%, groups 35%, tile+13 12%.

experiments.hypothesis: Fusion group size G=6 instead of 8
experiments.note: Best G differs by target. Follow-up hc-014.

experiments.hypothesis: 64-bit bit indices in the wheel sparse loop
experiments.note: Register spill: base pointer reloaded every OR. Fixed in hc-015.

experiments.hypothesis: Add the AVX-512 x8 target (vector dense in one zmm)
experiments.note: Chris to decide: small, AVX-512 only. Base now level with Rust at 1T on Zen 5 (124.5k vs 126.0k) and 13% ahead at 16T.

experiments.hypothesis: G=6 for AVX-512, 8 otherwise
experiments.note: Chris to decide: recommend keep.

experiments.hypothesis: 64-bit sparse indices without the spill (loop bounded on stream 0)
experiments.note: Merged into hc/champion.

experiments.hypothesis: No lead-ins in the fused group loop (RESEARCH idea 6)
experiments.note: Merged on top of hc-015; counts re-checked for 5,396 sizes on 3 targets.

experiments.hypothesis: Dense threshold 160 instead of 256 after the faster sparse loop
experiments.note: 256 stays. Stopped after 3 rounds.

experiments.hypothesis: Sparse loop unrolled by two chunks
experiments.note: Base levers exhausted for now.

experiments.hypothesis: hc-007 + hc-014 on top of the current champion (measurement for Chris)
experiments.note: Passes the rule as one change; waits for Chris because its parts were not accepted separately. Recommend merge.

experiments.hypothesis: Regression fix: scalar dense routine on NEON
experiments.where: Cobalt 100 +64% vs champion, level with the start; x86 identical
experiments.note: Regression fix merged.

experiments.hypothesis: Scoreboard: base champion (with hc-013) vs the start, with Rust and davepl C++ as rivals
experiments.note: At 1T ours leads davepl C++ by 51% (Zen 3), 35% (Zen 5), 28% (Cobalt). Rust: +5% Zen 3, level Zen 5, -4% Cobalt.

experiments.hypothesis: Rust: allow AVX-512 (config disabled it for Skylake)
experiments.note: Starts hc/rust-champion.

experiments.hypothesis: Rust: toolchain 1.88 on bookworm instead of 1.57 on buster
experiments.note: Rust 1.88 slower than 1.57 here.

experiments.hypothesis: Pointer walk over dense chunks (NEON: zero extension per word)
experiments.note: Arm gap to Rust lies elsewhere.

experiments.hypothesis: Rust: 64-byte aligned flag words (SMT scaling at 16T)
experiments.note: Alignment does not explain the Rust 16T gap.

experiments.hypothesis: First Zig entry: base and wheel vs ISPC and davepl
experiments.where: Zig wheel vs ISPC wheel: +17.7% Zen 3, +13.1% Zen 5 1T; Zig base -16%/-10% vs ISPC base
experiments.note: Zig wheel is our fastest wheel. Arm64 check running.

experiments.hypothesis: unmasked clear_factor: 13,924 masked moves to 4 on AVX2
experiments.note: 0-2% band: 10-round rerun queued.

experiments.hypothesis: Vector dense on NEON again (after hc-024)
experiments.note: NEON vector dense no faster than scalar.

experiments.hypothesis: Rust pointer-walk sparse loop
experiments.note: Rust 1.57 already compiles the sparse loop well.

experiments.hypothesis: r-04 plus Rust 1.88 toolchain
experiments.note: Rust 1.88 with AVX-512 collapses on Zen 5. Old toolchain stays.

experiments.hypothesis: Factor-3 pass initialises the sieve (vs hc-024)
experiments.note: Small, consistent. Held with hc-024.

experiments.hypothesis: Fused group loop, two vectors a trip (learnt from the Zig port)
experiments.note: The Zig wheel advantage is not the loop width.

events.text: Dashboard created. Waiting for the first autopilot run.
Autopilot ap-20261009T0607Z started in Azure mode. Lock taken.
Time box extended to 8 hours (until 00:07 AEST) by Chris; budget unchanged.
Profile (hc-001) launched on Zen pools. D16as_v5 node reported EPYC 9V74 (Zen 4), not the usual 7763.
Research agent started in the background. Dashboard gains Research and Where-the-cycles-go sections.
hc-001 Zen 4 profile in: 70% of the base gap to Rust is the dense phase.
hc-002 (vector dense) launched on D16as_v5 and D16as_v7.
hc-001 done. Where the cycles go is in STATUS.md and on this page.
Research agent finished: RESEARCH.md committed. Adopted: wheel masked tails, wheel 13 fast path, base dense limit. solution_3: not now.
hc-002 vector dense: +23% 1T, +28% 16T on Zen 4 and Zen 5. Confirming on fresh nodes before merging.
D16a_v4 gives a real Zen 3 (EPYC 7763); D16as_v5 gave Zen 4 twice today.
hc-003 KEPT and merged: base sparse pointer walk, Zen 5 +12.3% 1T.
hc-005 (wheel unmasked stores) launched on Zen 3 and Zen 5.
hc-002 confirm so far: Zen 3 +21.9%, Zen 5 +22.9% at 1T. hc-005 Zen 3 +8% at 1T so far.
hc-002 confirmed and merged: base +22-24% 1T. Base now beats Rust at 1T on Zen 3 (+3%) and Zen 4 (+2%).
hc-005 rejected: wheel unmasked stores +4.5% Zen 3, -1.7% Zen 5.
hc-004 KEPT and merged: wheel lone-prime path, +4.9% to +8.7% at 1T.
hc-006 inconclusive: Zen 5 +4.0% clean, Zen 3 node noisy (control moved 36k-59k). Rerun as hc-006b.
Harness: candidates now rebased on the current champion and BASE pinned to a commit.
hc-006 KEPT and merged: wheel --addressing=64, Zen 3 +3.5% 16T, Zen 5 +4.0% 1T.
hc-007 to Chris: AVX2-only unmasked stores +4% to +5% on Zen 3 and Zen 4, Zen 5 code identical.
hc-008 rejected (tile memcpy flat on Zen 5). hc-010 re-profile launched.
hc-009 rejected (base word scan, -1.4% Zen 5). hc-010: base now level with Rust on Zen 5 per phase.
hc-011 (G=6) and hc-012 (wheel sparse 64-bit indices) running.
hc-011 (G=6) Zen 5: +4.5% 1T, +6% at 4-8T, flat at 16T. Zen 3 running.
hc-011 rejected (G=6 hurts Zen 3 1T). hc-014 makes G per target; Zen 5 data carries over.
hc-012 rejected (Zen 5 16T -2.1% from a register spill); hc-015 fixes the spill and is running.
hc-014 confirmed on Zen 4 AVX-512: +4.3% 1T. hc-013 base AVX-512 +1.0% only. hc-016 (no lead-ins) launched.
hc-015 KEPT and merged: wheel sparse loop without the spill, +5% to +7% on Zen 3 and Zen 5 at 1T and 16T.
hc-016 KEPT and merged: wheel without lead-ins, +5% Zen 3, +2.6% Zen 5.
hc-017 rejected (dense 160 slower). hc-019 measures the target-specific pair on the current champion.
Experiments frozen except hc-018/019 finishing. Final scoreboard runs starting (both entries; Zen 3, Zen 4 AVX-512, Zen 5, Cobalt 100).
hc-019: target-specific pair +6.4% 1T on Zen 5, +2.3% 16T on Zen 3. Waiting for Chris. hc-018 rejected.
Final: wheel champion +21.7% 1T Zen 3, +19.5% 1T Zen 5 against the start of the run; +51% and +29% over C5.
Final: base champion +24.1% 1T on Zen 3 against the start of the run; 5.4% ahead of Rust.
Final: base champion +43.1% 1T and +43.8% 16T on Zen 5 against the start; level with Rust at 1T, 13% ahead at 16T.
Final: wheel champion +13.0% 1T on Zen 4 (AVX-512); lead over C5 at 1T now 15.5% (was 2%).
Final run found a regression: base -38.9% on Cobalt 100 (arm64). Cause: NEON scalarises the vector dense code. Fix hc-020 running.
hc-020 merged: base on Cobalt 100 back to the start of the run (41.0k); x86 unchanged.
Run stopped at 21:05 AEST. Spend NZ$4.02. No pools left. Morning report in STATUS.md.
Run ap-20261009T1112Z started: merges and docs, then ISPC vs davepl, Rust and Zig.
Merged hc-019 (target-specific pair) and hc-013 (base AVX-512), approved by Chris. Self-tests and sweeps pass.
Harness: persistent auto-scaling pools in use. davepl C++ added as a rival. Research pass 2 and a Zig first pass running in the background.
davepl C++ at 1T: ours ahead by 51% Zen 3, 35% Zen 5, 28% Cobalt 100. Measuring davepl at all threads next.
Rust r-01 kept: AVX-512 on, +2.4% 1T, +4.9% 16T on Zen 5. hc/rust-champion created.
hc-023 and r-02 rejected. davepl at 16T on Zen 3: ours ahead by 40%.
Research pass 2 done: Rust already tops base on 5 runners except TR 1T; davepl is not top. Found 13,924 masked moves in our dense code (hc-024).
Zig first pass: the Zig wheel beats the ISPC wheel at 1T (+16.5% Zen 3, +12.4% Zen 5). Porting its 32-word loop back to ISPC (hc-027).
Zig wheel final: +17.7% (Zen 3) and +13.1% (Zen 5) over the ISPC wheel at 1T; Zig base 10-16% behind ISPC base.
Zen 4 (AVX-512) pool created for the final scoreboard. r-04/r-05 rejected; hc-026 +0.7-1.1%.

research.note: Research pass 2: RESEARCH-2.md and results/leaderboard-2026-10-09b.md. Rust already tops the faithful 1-bit base table on all five runners except Threadripper 1T (Swift, +3.4%). davepl ranks fifth on multi-thread and reports no 1T line.
